title: PDFio before 1.6.5 contains an integer underflow in _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() in pdfio-aes.c, which strips PKCS#7…
description: PDFio versions before 1.6.5 have an integer underflow vulnerability in the _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() function within pdfio-aes.c. This flaw occurs when PKCS#7 padding is stripped before any AES block is decrypted if an AES-encrypted string or binary value contains only its 16-byte initialization vector (IV). A crafted AES-encrypted PDF opened with pdfioFileOpen() can trigger a length underflow, causing _pdfioValueDecrypt() to read and write out of bounds, potentially crashing the application or corrupting heap memory.
